scope: Local prepared mixed-workload comparison; not full sysbench or TPC-C acceptance
change: Use the existing per-region TxnLockFast backoff for scan lock recovery; remaining TTL is a ceiling, not the sleep duration
machine: Apple M4 Max, 128 GiB RAM, Darwin 24.6.0
cluster: One local PD, TiKV, Go TiDB; v9.0.0-beta.2.pre-nightly

data.state: Shared dataset previously exercised by mixed workloads; not a fresh MVCC history

reproduce: python3 rust/scripts/compare-sysbench.py --server before:53004 --server after:53005 --server go:45000 --database perf_sysbench_clean --workload oltp_read_write --threads 2 --seconds 30 --rounds 3 --table-size 100000
notes: Both Rust binaries include the locked-unwritten-secondary cleanup, unique scan-ready queue, and scan panic error propagation. Only the scan lock-backoff change differs. No builds or profiling ran during these nine samples. TPS uses actual elapsed time, including the pre-change overruns. No samples were discarded.
